# Lagomorph
An artifically-uplifted species of anthromorphic mammals that have a clear resemblance with Sol's Lagomorpha. Corporate interests saw their uplifting upon first contact as a necessary solution to a labor shortage.
- Receive [color=#ffa500]25% more heat damage[/color] and [color=#1e90ff]25% less cold damage[/color], [color=yellow]50% more stamina damage[/color], and [color=#1e90ff]10% less blunt damage[/color]. - Metabolic Processes engage [color=#ffa500]50% faster[/color]. Remember to stay fed! - Deal [color=red]5[/color] slashing damage with claws. - Fall into crit at [color=#ffa500]90[/color] damage, with death occuring at [color=#ffa500]180[/color] damage. - Can hear people speak and whisper from 2 tiles further. - Can choose three of four unique species traits, representative of their genetic modifications.
## Language - Lagomorphs have a pigeon language of Sol Common adapted for usage in their laryanixcal vocal structure, adapting to certain characters and sounds they make. This is known as Laguine. - This pigeon language is used as a gateway for many to learn Galactic Common as a second language, through intense vocal training.
## Age and Names - Their naming structure is similar to standard human onomastics due to their origins of being an uplifted laborer species. - Through genetic manipulation by corporate interests and wider galactic quasi-governments, their lifespan is comparable to the average human.
